component.name: Rekindle
component.summary: Read a self-hosted comic, manga and book library

description.p: Rekindle is the desktop client for a self-hosted comic, manga and book server. Run the server on whichever machine holds your archive files, then connect from here to browse your libraries, read in a native reader, and download issues for offline use.
Multiple users are supported, each with their own reading progress and permission level, and a single client can be connected to several servers at once.

ul.li: Connect to multiple servers, each with its own libraries and progress
Paged and continuous-scroll reading, left-to-right or right-to-left
Double-page spreads detected automatically per page
Download issues to read while offline
Reading progress synced back to the server, and across devices

description.p: Supported formats: CBZ, CBR, EPUB, MOBI and PDF.
